title: THE CAVE GALLOWS // OATHKEEPER'S RED FURY
narrative: The hemp noose tightened around Podrick Payne's neck as Lady Stoneheart gestured with her gray, waterlogged hand. Brienne roared with primal fury. Breaking free from two outlaw guards, she drew Oathkeeper. The Valyrian steel blade flashed in the torchlight like folded rippling wine, cleaving through wood, leather, and bone. In four seconds, she severed the hanging rope, caught Podrick with one massive arm, and drove her pommel through the teeth of Lem Lemoncloak. Standing over the boy, blood spattering her freckled cheeks, she faced down thirty outlaws of the Hollow Hill alone.
resolvesPlotHole: How Brienne and Podrick Survived Stoneheart's Noose
